feature: Really love all the updates, man! This is getting really cool! I've thinking about how perfectly geared this is towards a social media platform. Obviously, the main premise is about logging your own movies and people reading your take, but it could be cool to feature a discrete comment button on the feed to briefly agree, disagree, and seed a dialogue to discuss the movie in person later on. Maybe some sort of dropdown attached to the individual movie reviews, I don't really know. Not the most pressing idea, but something to think about going forward. This is also to serve as a test for the feature request update! Kudos on all the work:)
